newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Protest at Hong Kong assembly over sexism, ageism.
newsitem.headline: Protest at Hong Kong assembly over sexism, ageism.

text.p: Several dozen women and children staged a noisy protest against sex and age bias, and discrimination against homosexuals, outside Hong Kong's legislature on Wednesday.
They heckled colonial-era lawmakers entering the chamber to try to push through a raft of laws before next Monday's handover of the British colony to China.
"We demand the Legislative Council stamp out ageism, sexism and discrimination based on sexual orientation," they shouted.
The legislature is holding its final session -- expected to end by Friday -- before the 156-year-old British colony reverts to China at midnight on June 30.
Pro-democracy legislator Lau Chin-shek has proposed a new equal opportunities bill targeting sexuality and age.
